name: Romania

flag.description: Three equal vertical stripes of blue, yellow and red from the hoist.
flag.symbolism: The colors come from the historical principalities of Wallachia and Moldavia, and are popularly said to stand for liberty, justice and fraternity.

hook: Romania is plain blue-yellow-red with a bright cobalt blue; Chad's blue is a darker indigo, and Andorra and Moldova carry a crest.
trivia: During the 1989 revolution, protesters cut the communist coat of arms out of the center of the flag.
Romania's flag is almost identical to Chad's; Chad raised the issue at the United Nations in 2004, but Romania kept its flag.
